page.overview:
Who is Cesar Alvarez?

Having witnessed his share of violence and death from an early age, Cesar Alvarez works across the Latin American sphere to destabilise criminal and corrupt organisations.

Destructive, he has skills in firearms, survival and driving, and is bi-lingual, speaking Spanish and English. The character offers a chance to deal 10 bonus damage and provides a +10 total offence using stun grenades, along with +20 HP in Conflict and Villain fights using flak jackets. He is an "uncommon agent" (white) and can be levelled to level 5.
